observations.native50MpGate: Real 10000x5000 import, actual WASM edit, original compressed bytes retained, save/reopen and native-size PNG output; unaffected by final SVG-only snapshot optimization.
observations.timingLimits: Single container observations. Final SVG browser run overlapped unit validation. Cancellation elapsed time includes queued UI work and is not an isolated encoder benchmark, p95, input-to-photon or heap measurement. No speedup or universal responsiveness claim is made.

independentOracles: Explicit world matrix [0,2,-1,1,104,15] and occupied bounds [92,19,101,52] for composed quarter-turn plus shear/scale.
Analytic pixel area for quadrilateral (102,19),(102,43),(92,53),(92,29), including exact half-covered diagonal pixels. Decoded SVG alpha maximum error 0.
Opaque path overlap must be composited once before four nested half-opacity factors: alpha 16 in exclusive and overlapping areas.
32 actual SVG/PNG interior comparisons: all 16 blend modes, with and without isolated nested content. Maximum channel difference 0.
Magnified native fractional geometry remains visible at 10000x scale; two-decimal serialization would collapse the rectangle.
Actual DOMParser round-trip retains quoted, angle-bracket, ampersand, newline/tab and supplementary-Unicode identifiers with no injected nodes.
Real scheduled task cancellation after anchor 5000 is read and before the last of 20000 anchors; no simulated AbortSignal or dropped path samples.
Host changes during encoding replace immutable model nodes: export keeps original placement and the later change remains exactly one undo step.
Production UI SVG download is decoded through HTMLImageElement; exact opaque-color/quarter-alpha samples and hidden-subtree exclusion; one undo removes preceding script edits.
harnessCorrections: This Chromium environment cannot decode SVG through createImageBitmap; SVG image checks use the actual HTMLImageElement decoder and Blob object URLs.

Initial direct SVG-versus-Canvas byte comparison revealed 22 edge pixel differences, maximum 24 alpha/premultiplied values. Added a strict independent analytic geometry/coverage oracle and retained bounded edge diagnostics rather than claiming byte parity. All native fully opaque/transparent pixels agree; total absolute coverage difference 206/255 of one pixel.
remaining: SVG masks, Blend If, color overlays and drop shadows are omitted and reported.
Raster/paint/text/adjustment/smart-object contents, including embedded vector masters, are omitted and reported; omitted backdrops can change blends.
Viewer support for CSS blend modes/isolation and renderer edge differences remain interoperability limits.
Standalone layer toSvg is synchronous and in its own parent plane; no ancestor/sibling context or accompanying report.
General SVG document import/round-trip, deeper editable interchange and remaining F11 formats remain incomplete.
SVG parts/Blob construction and UI presentation still have memory/main-thread costs; no device/peak-memory/performance gate is closed.
A12 bleed/alignment/legibility/contrast/export integration and the broader editing, color/RAW, semantic/matting, AI/evaluation, workflow/collaboration/commercial/specialist roadmap remain incomplete.
